name: Soap Stand
application: Covered Soap Dish with Drain Insert
tagline: A three-part covered soap dish sample marked '15% Limex', modeled in 3D from the supplied product photos.
description: A covered soap dish in three moulded parts: a cream pillow-domed lid with an all-over knitted rice-grain emboss and a sculpted bow, a matching cream base tray with a scalloped rim, and a sage-green drain insert with 13 drainage slots that lets the soap dry between uses. The sample lid interior is handwritten '15% Limex', indicating a 15% LIMEX blend for this trial part. The interactive 3D model is photo-matched to the supplied reference photography and animates the three-part assembly.
